title: FLEX-1 Methane Spherical Flame
description: Flame Extinguishment Experiment (FLEX) focusing on methane droplet combustion in microgravity.
observed_behavior: Flame formed a perfect sphere. Extinction occurred via radiative heat loss rather than convection.
research_findings: Demonstrated that purely radiative extinction limits exist for methane in microgravity.

title: BASS Propane Burn
description: Burning and Suppression of Solids (BASS) equivalent test using propane gas jets.
observed_behavior: Flame length increased compared to 1g due to lack of buoyancy-induced mixing.
research_findings: Soot volume fraction is higher in microgravity propane flames.
